title: Ghunnah
description: A nasal sound applied to Noon and Meem with shaddah.

title: Idgham
description: Merging of Noon Saakinah into the next letter.

title: Ikhfa
description: Hiding sound between clear and merged pronunciation.

title: Qalqalah
description: Echoing sound on ق ط ب ج د letters.
